source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: [Assault Doctrine](vsdata:ability/space-marines.combat-doctrines) makes **[[SUSTAINED HITS 1]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)** apply to all melee attacks by this unit. Otherwise only **non-MONSTER/VEHICLE** targets qualify.
